# TH01 native port -- CMake skeleton, derived from th03-port by copying.
#
# PROVENANCE. Every region of this file below this header is a verbatim line
# region of `th03-port/CMakeLists.txt` with exactly three tokens renamed
# (th03->th01, TH03->TH01, Th03->Th01). The region list, the source line ranges,
# the SHA-256 of each region on both sides, and every block that is NOT a copy
# are recorded in `th01-port/docs/COPY_DIFF.md`, generated by the same script
# that generated this file. Do not hand-edit either without updating that
# record: the point of building game #2 by copying rather than designing is that
# the copy stays diffable against its donor.
#
# W5a step 3 as written said to copy "the six no-TH03-identifier libraries".
# Measured (`state/port/TH01_PORT_SCOPE.md` section 6a): five of those six names
# occur in exactly one file in the repository -- the plan that names them. The
# sixth, `th03_platform_sdl`, is copied here, and section 6b records what that
# copy turned out to drag with it.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)

project(th01_port VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)

# GNU EXTENSIONS ARE OFF FOR EVERY TARGET, and it has to be said here rather
# than per target. `CXX_EXTENSIONS` is a target property that does NOT travel
# through a library's `PUBLIC cxx_std_23`, and its default is ON -- so every
# library set it explicitly and compiled `-std=c++23`, while all 80 test
# executables and all 4 apps inherited only the STANDARD and compiled
# `-std=gnu++23`. One test set it and was the only executable that did not.
# That is an inconsistency in the direction that fails silently: a test may use
# a GNU extension, pass, and be uncompilable in the library it is testing.
# Setting the default here covers apps, tests and every target added later,
# which is what makes it survive being copied per game.
#
# MEASURED: on MSVC this changes nothing at all -- extensions-off and
# extensions-on targets already emit identical `stdcpplatest` and identical
# additional options -- so this is a GCC/Clang normalization. The vendored
# ymfm target keeps its own lower standard; it already set this property.
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

include(CTest)

if(NOT TARGET pc98_numeric)
	add_subdirectory("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../shared"
		"${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/pc98-shared")
endif()

option(TH01_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS "Treat compiler warnings as errors" ON)
option(TH01_ENABLE_SDL "Build the optional SDL 3 platform adapter" OFF)

set(
	TH01_SDL3_PROVIDER "source" CACHE STRING
	"SDL 3 provider for the optional platform adapter (source or package)"
)
set_property(CACHE TH01_SDL3_PROVIDER PROPERTY STRINGS source package)
set(
	TH01_SDL3_SOURCE_DIR
	"${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/out/deps/SDL3-3.4.10" CACHE PATH
	"Authenticated SDL 3.4.10 source directory"
)
set(
	TH01_SDL3_LICENSE_FILE "" CACHE FILEPATH
	"SDL LICENSE.txt supplied by the package provider"
)

if(TH01_ENABLE_SDL)
	set(TH01_SDL3_VERSION "3.4.10")
	set(
		TH01_SDL3_SOURCE_SHA256
		"12b34280415ec8418c864408b93d008a20a6530687ee613d60bfbd20411f2785"
	)

	if(TH01_SDL3_PROVIDER STREQUAL "source")
		get_filename_component(
			_th01_sdl3_source "${TH01_SDL3_SOURCE_DIR}" ABSOLUTE
			BASE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}"
		)
		set(_th01_sdl3_marker "${_th01_sdl3_source}/.th01-source-sha256")
		set(_th01_sdl3_version_header
			"${_th01_sdl3_source}/include/SDL3/SDL_version.h"
		)
		set(_th01_sdl3_license_file "${_th01_sdl3_source}/LICENSE.txt")

		foreach(_required_file IN ITEMS
			"${_th01_sdl3_source}/CMakeLists.txt"
			"${_th01_sdl3_marker}"
			"${_th01_sdl3_version_header}"
			"${_th01_sdl3_license_file}"
		)
			if(NOT EXISTS "${_required_file}" OR IS_DIRECTORY "${_required_file}")
				message(FATAL_ERROR
					"Authenticated SDL ${TH01_SDL3_VERSION} source is incomplete: "
					"${_required_file}"
				)
			endif()
		endforeach()

		file(READ "${_th01_sdl3_marker}" _th01_sdl3_marker_value)
		string(STRIP "${_th01_sdl3_marker_value}" _th01_sdl3_marker_value)
		if(NOT _th01_sdl3_marker_value STREQUAL TH01_SDL3_SOURCE_SHA256)
			message(FATAL_ERROR
				"SDL source marker does not match the authenticated "
				"SDL ${TH01_SDL3_VERSION} release archive"
			)
		endif()

		file(READ "${_th01_sdl3_version_header}" _th01_sdl3_version_text)
		foreach(_version_part IN ITEMS
			"SDL_MAJOR_VERSION[ \t]+3"
			"SDL_MINOR_VERSION[ \t]+4"
			"SDL_MICRO_VERSION[ \t]+10"
		)
			if(NOT _th01_sdl3_version_text MATCHES
				"#[ \t]*define[ \t]+${_version_part}([^0-9]|$)"
			)
				message(FATAL_ERROR
					"SDL source version header is not exactly "
					"${TH01_SDL3_VERSION}"
				)
			endif()
		endforeach()

		file(SIZE "${_th01_sdl3_license_file}" _th01_sdl3_license_size)
		if(_th01_sdl3_license_size EQUAL 0)
			message(FATAL_ERROR "SDL LICENSE.txt is empty")
		endif()

		enable_language(C)
		set(SDL_SHARED ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
		set(SDL_STATIC OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
		set(SDL_TEST_LIBRARY OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
		set(SDL_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
		set(SDL_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
		set(SDL_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
		add_subdirectory(
			"${_th01_sdl3_source}"
			"${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/_deps/sdl3-build"
			EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
		)
	elseif(TH01_SDL3_PROVIDER STREQUAL "package")
		find_package(
			SDL3 ${TH01_SDL3_VERSION} EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED
			COMPONENTS SDL3-shared
		)
		if(TH01_SDL3_LICENSE_FILE STREQUAL "")
			message(FATAL_ERROR
				"The SDL package provider requires TH01_SDL3_LICENSE_FILE"
			)
		endif()
		get_filename_component(
			_th01_sdl3_license_file "${TH01_SDL3_LICENSE_FILE}" ABSOLUTE
			BASE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}"
		)
		if(NOT EXISTS "${_th01_sdl3_license_file}" OR
			IS_DIRECTORY "${_th01_sdl3_license_file}"
		)
			message(FATAL_ERROR
				"TH01_SDL3_LICENSE_FILE must name the package's SDL license file"
			)
		endif()
		file(SIZE "${_th01_sdl3_license_file}" _th01_sdl3_license_size)
		if(_th01_sdl3_license_size EQUAL 0)
			message(FATAL_ERROR "The package's SDL license file is empty")
		endif()
	else()
		message(FATAL_ERROR
			"TH01_SDL3_PROVIDER must be either 'source' or 'package'"
		)
	endif()

	if(NOT TARGET SDL3::SDL3-shared)
		message(FATAL_ERROR
			"The selected SDL provider did not define SDL3::SDL3-shared"
		)
	endif()

	function(th01_stage_sdl3_runtime target)
		if(NOT TARGET ${target})
			message(FATAL_ERROR
				"th01_stage_sdl3_runtime received an unknown target: ${target}"
			)
		endif()
		set(_license_destination
			"$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${target}>/licenses/SDL3"
		)
		add_custom_command(
			TARGET ${target} POST_BUILD
			COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E make_directory
				"${_license_destination}"
			COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E copy_if_different
				"${_th01_sdl3_license_file}"
				"${_license_destination}/LICENSE.txt"
			VERBATIM
		)
		if(WIN32)
			add_custom_command(
				TARGET ${target} POST_BUILD
				COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E copy_if_different
					"$<TARGET_FILE:SDL3::SDL3-shared>"
					"$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${target}>"
				VERBATIM
			)
		endif()
	endfunction()
endif()

function(th01_set_warnings target)
	if(MSVC)
		target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE /W4 /permissive- /Zc:preprocessor)
		if(TH01_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS)
			target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE /WX)
		endif()
	else()
		target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE
			-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wconversion -Wsign-conversion
		)
		if(TH01_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS)
			target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -Werror)
		endif()
	endif()
endfunction()

# Imported permissive dependencies keep their upstream diagnostics rather than
# entering the port-owned warning-as-error contract. All adapter/shim code below
# still uses th01_set_warnings().
function(th01_silence_vendor_warnings target)
	if(MSVC)
		target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE /W0)
	else()
		target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -w)
	endif()
endfunction()

function(th01_stage_audio_licenses target)
	if(NOT TARGET ${target})
		message(FATAL_ERROR
			"th01_stage_audio_licenses received an unknown target: ${target}"
		)
	endif()
	foreach(_dependency IN ITEMS 98fmplayer ymfm)
		add_custom_command(
			TARGET ${target} POST_BUILD
			COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E make_directory
				"$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${target}>/licenses/${_dependency}"
			COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E copy_if_different
				"${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/${_dependency}/LICENSE"
				"$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${target}>/licenses/${_dependency}/LICENSE"
			VERBATIM
		)
	endforeach()
endfunction()

# One test executable and its CTest entry.
#
# Every hand-written test block in this file did the same things in the same
# order and differed only in which optional parts were present. Declaring them
# through one function preserves that order -- and therefore the generated
# compile flags, link command and POST_BUILD staging -- while making the test
# surface of a ported game a list of calls instead of a thousand lines of
# copy-paste. Sibling ports get the same function under their own prefix; this
# is a per-game declaration helper, not a shared pc98_* library.
#
#	th01_add_test(<name>
#		SOURCES <file>...            translation units for the executable
#		[LINK <target>...]           PRIVATE link libraries
#		[INCLUDE <dir>...]           PRIVATE include directories, for tests
#		                             that reach into src/ for internals
#		[ENVIRONMENT <var=value>...] CTest ENVIRONMENT property. Pass each
#		                             assignment as its OWN argument. A single
#		                             quoted "A=1;B=2" arrives here through
#		                             PARSE_ARGV with its semicolons escaped
#		                             and would reach CTest as one setting.
#		[MSVC_LINK_OPTIONS <opt>...] link options applied only under MSVC
#		[STAGE_SDL3]                 stage the SDL runtime and license beside
#		                             the executable (TH01_ENABLE_SDL only)
#		[STAGE_AUDIO_LICENSES]       stage the vendored audio licenses
#	)
#
# The CTest name is always the target name: no existing block differed, and
# keeping them equal is what lets a failing test be built by its own name.
function(th01_add_test name)
	cmake_parse_arguments(
		PARSE_ARGV 1 arg
		"STAGE_SDL3;STAGE_AUDIO_LICENSES"
		""
		"SOURCES;LINK;INCLUDE;ENVIRONMENT;MSVC_LINK_OPTIONS"
	)
	# A mistyped keyword would otherwise silently become a source file, and a
	# keyword with no value would silently drop an include directory. At ~400
	# call sites across five games, both need to be loud.
	if(arg_UNPARSED_ARGUMENTS)
		message(FATAL_ERROR
			"th01_add_test(${name}): unrecognised arguments: "
			"${arg_UNPARSED_ARGUMENTS}"
		)
	endif()
	if(arg_KEYWORDS_MISSING_VALUES)
		message(FATAL_ERROR
			"th01_add_test(${name}): keywords given with no value: "
			"${arg_KEYWORDS_MISSING_VALUES}"
		)
	endif()
	if(NOT arg_SOURCES)
		message(FATAL_ERROR "th01_add_test(${name}): SOURCES is required")
	endif()

	add_executable(${name} ${arg_SOURCES})
	if(arg_LINK)
		target_link_libraries(${name} PRIVATE ${arg_LINK})
	endif()
	if(arg_INCLUDE)
		target_include_directories(${name} PRIVATE ${arg_INCLUDE})
	endif()
	if(MSVC AND arg_MSVC_LINK_OPTIONS)
		target_link_options(${name} PRIVATE ${arg_MSVC_LINK_OPTIONS})
	endif()
	th01_set_warnings(${name})
	if(arg_STAGE_SDL3)
		th01_stage_sdl3_runtime(${name})
	endif()
	if(arg_STAGE_AUDIO_LICENSES)
		th01_stage_audio_licenses(${name})
	endif()
	add_test(NAME ${name} COMMAND ${name})
	if(arg_ENVIRONMENT)
		set_tests_properties(
			${name} PROPERTIES ENVIRONMENT "${arg_ENVIRONMENT}"
		)
	endif()
endfunction()

# The skeleton's own self-test, and the only target that builds in the DEFAULT
# configuration.
#
# WHY IT EXISTS. Two reasons, both measured rather than stylistic.
#
# 1. `th01_add_test()` was copied with no call site that builds by default --
#    the three copied ones are all behind `TH01_ENABLE_SDL`, which is OFF. A
#    build gate over an empty target set is green forever and measures nothing.
#
# 2. The comment on this file's own `set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)` records the
#    defect it is guarding: on th03-port, `CXX_EXTENSIONS` defaulted to ON for
#    80 test executables and 4 apps while every library set it explicitly, and
#    that "fails silently: a test may use a GNU extension, pass, and be
#    uncompilable in the library it is testing". The directory-scoped `set()` is
#    the fix; nothing checked that it reached a target. This does.
if(BUILD_TESTING)
	th01_add_test(th01-skeleton-tests
		SOURCES tests/test_skeleton.cpp
	)
	target_compile_features(th01-skeleton-tests PRIVATE cxx_std_23)
endif()

add_library(th01_core STATIC src/core/input.cpp src/core/shots.cpp src/core/orb.cpp
	src/core/shot_orb.cpp src/core/player.cpp src/core/gameplay.cpp
	src/core/projectiles.cpp src/core/stage.cpp src/core/boss.cpp src/core/boss_konngara.cpp
	src/core/boss_mima.cpp src/core/boss_kikuri.cpp
	src/core/boss_yuugenmagan.cpp src/core/boss_elis.cpp src/core/boss_sariel.cpp)
target_include_directories(th01_core PUBLIC include)
target_link_libraries(th01_core PUBLIC pc98_numeric)
th01_set_warnings(th01_core)
add_executable(th01-headless src/headless.cpp)
target_link_libraries(th01-headless PRIVATE th01_core)
th01_set_warnings(th01-headless)
if(MSVC)
	target_compile_options(th01_core PRIVATE /fp:strict)
else()
	target_compile_options(th01_core PRIVATE -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off -frounding-math)
endif()
if(BUILD_TESTING)
	th01_add_test(th01-player-tests SOURCES tests/test_player.cpp LINK th01_core)
	th01_add_test(th01-gameplay-tests SOURCES tests/test_gameplay.cpp LINK th01_core)
	th01_add_test(th01-boss-singyoku-tests SOURCES tests/test_boss_singyoku.cpp LINK th01_core)
	th01_add_test(th01-boss-konngara-tests SOURCES tests/test_boss_konngara.cpp LINK th01_core)
	th01_add_test(th01-boss-mima-tests SOURCES tests/test_boss_mima.cpp LINK th01_core)
	th01_add_test(th01-boss-kikuri-tests SOURCES tests/test_boss_kikuri.cpp LINK th01_core)
	th01_add_test(th01-boss-yuugenmagan-tests SOURCES tests/test_boss_yuugenmagan.cpp LINK th01_core)
	th01_add_test(th01-boss-elis-tests SOURCES tests/test_boss_elis.cpp LINK th01_core)
	th01_add_test(th01-boss-sariel-tests SOURCES tests/test_boss_sariel.cpp LINK th01_core)
	add_test(NAME th01-headless-help COMMAND th01-headless --help)
	th01_add_test(th01-projectile-tests SOURCES tests/test_projectiles.cpp LINK th01_core)
	th01_add_test(th01-stage-tests SOURCES tests/test_stage.cpp LINK th01_core)
	add_executable(th01-stage-sweep tests/stage_sweep.cpp)
	target_link_libraries(th01-stage-sweep PRIVATE th01_core)
	th01_set_warnings(th01-stage-sweep)
	add_test(NAME th01-stage-sweep-help COMMAND th01-stage-sweep --help)
	th01_add_test(th01-orb-vertical-tests
		SOURCES tests/test_orb_vertical.cpp
		LINK th01_core
	)
	th01_add_test(th01-core-tests
		SOURCES tests/test_core.cpp
		LINK th01_core
	)
	th01_add_test(th01-shot-tests
		SOURCES tests/test_shots.cpp
		LINK th01_core
	)
	th01_add_test(th01-shot-orb-tests
		SOURCES tests/test_shot_orb.cpp
		LINK th01_core
	)
endif()

# TH01's renderer model.
#
# This is the first library in this tree that is TH01's own rather than a copy
# of a `th03-port` target, and `th01-port/docs/RENDERER_MODEL.md` is the
# measurement that licenses each part of it. It is deliberately ONE translation
# unit: the campaign's standing rule is to build game #2 by copying and to
# extract only what is provably identical, and a renderer written to a design
# rather than to a diff earns exactly as much surface as the measurement pays
# for. Everything the donor tree already models game-neutrally -- palette, TRAM,
# GRCG write modes, scroll, the 200-line window -- is deliberately absent here
# and stays a copy-when-needed item, not a rewrite.
add_library(th01_present STATIC
	src/present/vram.cpp
)
target_include_directories(th01_present PUBLIC include)
target_compile_features(th01_present PUBLIC cxx_std_23)
set_target_properties(th01_present PROPERTIES CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
th01_set_warnings(th01_present)

if(BUILD_TESTING)
	th01_add_test(th01-present-vram-tests
		SOURCES tests/test_present_vram.cpp
		LINK th01_present
	)
endif()

if(TH01_ENABLE_SDL)
	add_library(th01_platform_sdl STATIC
		src/platform/sdl_audio_device.cpp
		src/platform/sdl_input.cpp
		src/platform/sdl_platform.cpp
	)
	target_include_directories(th01_platform_sdl PUBLIC include)
	target_link_libraries(
		th01_platform_sdl
		PUBLIC th01_app_runtime th01_audio_pmd SDL3::SDL3-shared
	)
	target_compile_features(th01_platform_sdl PUBLIC cxx_std_23)
	set_target_properties(th01_platform_sdl PROPERTIES CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
	th01_set_warnings(th01_platform_sdl)
endif()

# The copied library's own tests. `th03-app-sdl-defaults-tests`
# (th03-port/CMakeLists.txt:826-833) is NOT copied: its sources include
# `apps/th03-app/default_bindings.cpp`, and `apps/` is TH03 application scene
# code that W5a step 3 does not copy.
if(BUILD_TESTING)
	if(TH01_ENABLE_SDL)
		th01_add_test(th01-platform-sdl-input-tests
			SOURCES tests/test_platform_sdl_input.cpp
			LINK th01_platform_sdl
			ENVIRONMENT SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy SDL_RENDER_DRIVER=software
			STAGE_SDL3
		)
		th01_add_test(th01-platform-sdl-platform-tests
			SOURCES tests/test_platform_sdl_platform.cpp
			LINK th01_platform_sdl
			INCLUDE src/platform
			ENVIRONMENT SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy SDL_RENDER_DRIVER=software
			STAGE_SDL3
		)
		th01_add_test(th01-platform-sdl-audio-tests
			SOURCES tests/test_platform_sdl_audio.cpp
			LINK th01_platform_sdl
			INCLUDE src/platform
			ENVIRONMENT
				SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy
				SDL_RENDER_DRIVER=software
				SDL_AUDIO_DRIVER=dummy
			STAGE_SDL3
			STAGE_AUDIO_LICENSES
		)
	endif()
endif()
